title: A Servant's Prayer
text: O LORD, God of my master Abraham … please grant me success today …

title: Before He Finished Praying
text: Before the servant had finished praying, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder.

title: Water for the Camels
text: I will also draw water for your camels, until they have had enough to drink.

title: The LORD Led Me
text: … the LORD has led me on the journey …

title: His Angel Before You
text: … He will send His angel before you …

title: Two Miles
text: … if someone forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.

title: Thousands upon Thousands
text: … may you become the mother of thousands upon thousands.
